name: Guangdong Golden Dragon Development Inc.
summary: Guangdong Golden Dragon Development Inc. engages in securities business in China. It is involved in the securities brokerage; securities trading business; agency sale of financial products; future brokerage; investment banking; securities underwriting and sponsorship; financial consultancy; asset and fund management; credit transactions; investment consulting; and private equity and alternative investment businesses. Guangdong Golden Dragon Development Inc. was formerly known as Guangdong Jintai Development Co., Ltd. and changed its name to Guangdong Golden Dragon Development Inc. in July 2001. The company was founded in 1997 and is based in Qingyuan, China.
